# Download sequences from GenBank and visualize
```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 12}
### Load libraries
library(ape)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(tidyverse)

accs <- read_csv("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/mtdna/REG-ND2-specimens.csv")
    ### Assign GenBank accessions as sample names when not provided
    accs$specimen[is.na(accs$specimen)] <- accs$genbank[is.na(accs$specimen)]

unique(accs$species)
unique(accs$subspecies)

accs$subspecies[na.omit(accs$subspecies == "ignigularis?")] <- "ignigularis"
accs$subspecies[na.omit(accs$subspecies == "ravitergum?")] <- "ravitergum"

### Visualize sampling distribution
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(returnclass = "sf", scale = "large")

ggplot() + geom_sf(data = world) +
    coord_sf(xlim = c(-74.55, -68.25),
        ylim = c(17.4, 20.2)) +
    geom_point(data = accs, aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = subspecies), size = 3) +
    theme_classic() + xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude")

### Split dominicensis into east and west nuclear groups based on lat/long
accs$subspecies[na.omit(accs$longitude < -70.5 & accs$latitude < 19 & accs$subspecies == "dominicensis")] <- "dominicensis_W"
accs$subspecies[accs$subspecies == "dominicensis"] <- "dominicensis_E"

accs$taxa = paste(accs$species, accs$subspecies, sep = "_")

### Define color scheme for all taxa

  "websteri_NA" = "#000000"
)

col_labs <- c(
```

# Align sequences & infer ML tree

Using `mafft`, align the ND2 sequences from GenBank
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
module load mafft/7.475

mafft --auto distichoid_ND2.fasta > distichoid_ND2_aln.fasta
```

After alignment, use `iqtree` to infer a maximum likelihood tree
```{bash, eval = FALSE}
#! /usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --partition jro0014_amd
#SBATCH --mem 8G
#SBATCH --time 4:00:00
#SBATCH --output out.mtTree
#SBATCH --error err.mtTree

source ~/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate phyloenv

MSA=/home/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-ms/mtdna/distichoid_ND2_aln.fasta

iqtree -s $MSA -m MFP -bb 1000 -alrt 1000 -st DNA -seed 2022 -nt AUTO
```

```{r}
library(ggtree)
library(tidytree)

unique(accs$taxa)
cols <- setNames(c(
            "#2043C2", # brevirostris deserticola
            "#B83B15", # west dominicensis
            "#BBDB8B", # ravitergum
            "#FFE684", # favillarum

            "#64A1D1", # dominicensis/ignigularis
            "#99C463", # ignigularis/properus
            "#BDA425", # properus
            "#87DB41", # sejunctus
            "#DB0CC4", # aurifer
            "#DB8CA3", # vinosus
            "#2E4766", # east dominicensis
            "#000000", # websteri
            "#93BBBD", # caudalis
            "#756CA3", # marron
            "#202A71" # brevirostris wetmorei
    ),
        unique(accs$taxa)
)
col_labs <- c("A. b. deserticola",  "A. d. dominicensis - West", "A. d. ravitergum", "A. d. favillarum", "A. d. ignigularis", "A. d. ravitergum/ignigularis",
        "A. d. dominicensis/ignigularis", "A. d. properus/ignigularis", "A. d. properus", "A. d. sejunctus",
        "A. d. aurifer",  "A. d. vinosus", "A. d. dominicensis - East", "A. websteri",
        "A. caudalis", "A. marron", "A. b. wetmorei")

accs <- accs %>% mutate(Color = cols[taxa])
tip_colors <- accs %>% select(tip, Color) %>% deframe()

# Parse the support values
parse_support <- function(label) {
  if (is.na(label) || label == "") return(c(NA, NA))
    parts <- strsplit(as.character(label), "/")[[1]]
    shalrt <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    ufboot <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    return(c(shalrt, ufboot))
}
# Extract UFboot and SH-aLRT values
support_values <- t(sapply(tree2$node.label, parse_support))
shalrt <- support_values[, 1]
ufboot <- support_values[, 2]

# Replace labels with NA where BOTH values exceed thresholds
tree2$node.label <- ifelse(shalrt >= 80 & ufboot >= 95, 
                           "supported", 
                           tree2$node.label)

p <- ggtree(tree2) +
    geom_tiplab(size = 4, family = "Helvetica", offset = 0.0001) +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
    geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip & label == "supported"),
            size  = 2,
            color = "black",
            shape = 16) + # filled circle to replace node labels
#    geom_nodelab(aes(subset = !isTip),
        # size = 2,
        # hjust = -0.2,
        # color = "gray40") +
#   geom_text(aes(label = node), size = 2, color = "blue") + # Show node labels for mapping
    theme(legend.position = "none",
            axis.line.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
    hexpand(.3)

viewClade(p, 1886) # favillarum
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/favillarum_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 24)
viewClade(p, 1720) # west A. d. dominicensis
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/west_dominicensis_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 24)
viewClade(p, 1717) # Tiburon subspecies
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/tiburon_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300)
viewClade(p, 1715) # Western A. distichus subspecies
viewClade(p, 1121) # brevirostris clade
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/brevirostris_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 24)
viewClade(p, 2000) # East A. d. dominicensis
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/east_dominicensis_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 24)
viewClade(p, 1126) # ignigularis/ravitergum
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/ignigularis_ravitergum_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 24)
viewClade(p, 1443) # ignigularis/properus
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/ignigularis_properus_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 14, height = 30)
viewClade(p, 1707) # properus/sejunctus
    # ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/properus_sejunctus_subsetted_ND2_tree.png", dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 24)
```

## Collapse nodes to visualize relationships among major clades
```{r}
library(ggnewscale)

clade_info <- tibble(
        node  = c(1886, 1720, 2159, 1121,
                2000, 1126, 1443, 1707),
        label = c("A. d. favillarum", "A. d. dominicensis - W", "A. d. aurifer & A. d. vinosus", "A. brevirostris complex",
            "A. d. dominicensis - E", "A. d. ignigularis/ravitergum", "A. d. ignigularis/properus", "A. d. properus/sejunctus"),  # clade names
  fill  = cols[c("distichus_favillarum", "distichus_dominicensis_W", "distichus_aurifer", "brevirostris_deserticola",
            "distichus_dominicensis_E", "distichus_ravitergum/ignigularis", "distichus_properus/ignigularis", "distichus_sejunctus")]  # matched colors
)

# Collapse all clades iteratively
p_collapsed <- ggtree(tree2, branch.length = "none")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(clade_info))) {
  p_collapsed <- collapse(p_collapsed,
                           node  = clade_info$node[i],
                           mode  = "mixed",
                           fill  = clade_info$fill[i],
                           alpha = 0.8)
}

# # Uncollapsed taxa info
# uncollapsed_info <- tibble(
#   node  = c(1050, 1053, 2136, 631),  # replace with actual node numbers
#   label = c("A. websteri", "A. marron", "A. caudalis", "A. d. vinosus"),
#   fill  = cols[c("websteri_NA", "marron_NA", "caudalis_NA", "distichus_vinosus")] 
# )

# Add clade labels and bootstrap support on remaining nodes
p_collapsed +
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 2) +
        geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip & label == "supported"),
            size  = 2,
            color = "black",
            shape = 16) + # filled circle
        # geom_tiplab(aes(color = label),
        #         size = 2,
        #         offset = 0.1,
        #         fontface = "italic") +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        new_scale_color() +
        geom_cladelab(data = clade_info,
                mapping = aes(node = node,
                        label = label,
                        color = fill),
                        fontsize = 5,
                        fontface = "italic",
                        offset = 0.05,
                        offset.text = 0.1,
                        align = TRUE,
                        barsize = 0.5) +
        # geom_cladelab(data = uncollapsed_info,
        #         mapping = aes(node = node,
        #         label = label,
        #         color = fill),
        #         fontsize = 5,
        #         fontface = "italic",
        #         offset = 0.05,
        #         offset.text = 0.1,
        #         align = FALSE,
        #         barsize = 0,
        #         barcolour = NA) +
        scale_color_identity() +
        # geom_nodelab(aes(subset = !isTip),
        #         size = 2,
        #         hjust = -0.2,
        #         color = "gray40") +
        theme_tree() +
        theme(legend.position = "none") +
        hexpand(.8)

# ggsave("~/Dropbox/Apps/Overleaf/distichus_tree/supplemental/supp-figs/ND2-tree-entire-sampling-collapsed-clades.png",
#    dpi = 300, height = 15, width = 15)
```

# Subset to only include samples with ddRAD data
```{r}
samp_df <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv")
samp_df_mt <- samp_df[samp_df$mt_genbank != "#N/A",]
unique(samp_df_mt$taxon)

### these accessions don't have ddRAD data, but are from populations that do
just_mt <- accs %>% filter(subspecies %in% c("aurifer", "vinosus") | species %in% c("websteri", "caudalis", "marron")) %>% select(genbank)

mt_samples <- c(samp_df_mt$specimen, accs$specimen[accs$genbank %in% just_mt$genbank])

mt_tips <- tree2$tip.label %>% str_split_fixed("_", n = 2) %>% .[,1]
keepers <- mt_tips %in% mt_samples

kept_tips <- tree2$tip.label[keepers]
tree2_RAD <- keep.tip(tree2, kept_tips)

plot.phylo(tree2_RAD, show.node.label = TRUE)
```

## If re-inferring tree with reduced sampling
```{r, eval = FALSE}
################################################################################
### load aligned ND2 sequence with all specimens
nd2 <- read.FASTA("~/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/mtdna/distichoid_ND2_aln.fasta", type = "DNA")
### subset to include selections 
nd2 <- nd2[names(nd2) %in% c(samp_df_mt$mt_genbank, just_mt$genbank)]

### change the names from GenBank accessions to more informative names
for (i in 1:length(names(nd2))){
    if (names(nd2)[i] %in% samp_df_mt$mt_genbank){
        names(nd2)[i] <- paste0(samp_df_mt$specimen[samp_df_mt$mt_genbank == names(nd2)[i]], "_", samp_df_mt$taxon[samp_df_mt$mt_genbank == names(nd2)[i]])
    } else {
        if (accs$species[accs$genbank == names(nd2)[i]] == "distichus") {
            names(nd2)[i] <- paste0(accs$specimen[accs$genbank == names(nd2)[i]], "_", accs$subspecies[accs$genbank == names(nd2)[i]])    
        } else {
        names(nd2)[i] <- paste0(accs$specimen[accs$genbank == names(nd2)[i]], "_", accs$species[accs$genbank == names(nd2)[i]])
        }
    }
}

write.dna(nd2, file = '/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/data/mtdna/select_ND2_aln.fa', format = 'fasta', nbcol = -1, colsep = "")
```

## Read in concatenated ddRAD tree and compare to mtDNA tree
```{r, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 16}
rad_tree <- read.tree("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/phylo/iqtree-concat/concat_miss90LD.treefile")
rad_tree$tip.label <- str_split(rad_tree$tip.label, pattern = "\\.", simplify = T)[,1]
rad_tree$tip.label %in% samp_df$specimen

samp_df$population_post[samp_df$population_post == "dom2"] <- "east_dominicensis"
samp_df$population_post[samp_df$population_post == "dom4"] <- "west_dominicensis"

samp_df <- samp_df[match(rad_tree$tip.label, samp_df$specimen),]
rad_tree$tip.label <- paste(rad_tree$tip.label, samp_df$population_post, sep = "_")

rad_tree2 <- midpoint(rad_tree)
plot(rad_tree2, show.node.label = TRUE)

rad_w_mt <- samp_df %>% filter(specimen %in% df$samples) %>% select(specimen, population_post)
### grab taxa with ND2 representatives but no ddRAD data, but are from populations that do have ddRAD data
rad_wo_mt <- samp_df %>% filter(population_post %in% c("aurifer", "vinosus", "websteri", "caudalis", "marron")) %>% select(specimen, population_post)

rad_samples <- as_tibble(rbind(rad_w_mt, rad_wo_mt))
keepers <- paste(rad_samples$specimen, rad_samples$population_post, sep = "_")

rad_tree2 <- keep.tip(rad_tree2, keepers)

rad_samples <- rad_samples[match(rad_tree2$tip.label, paste(rad_samples$specimen, rad_samples$population_post, sep = "_")),]
rad_tree2$taxon <- rad_samples$population_post

cols <- setNames(c("#DB0CC4", # aurifer
        "#2E4766", # dom2
        "#202AC2", # brevirostris
        "#93BBBD", # caudalis
        "#756CA3", # marron
        "#000000", # websteri
        "#BBDB8B", # ravitergum
        "#30C7AB", # west ignigularis
        "#28C3D1", # east ignigularis
        "#BDA425", # properus
        "#87DB41", # sejunctus
        "#B83B15", # dom4
        "#FFE684", # favillarum
        "#DB8CA3" # vinosus
        ),
        unique(rad_samples$population_post)
)
col_labs <- unique(rad_samples$population_post)

rad_samples <- rad_samples %>% mutate(Color = cols[population_post],
                             tip_label = paste(specimen, population_post, sep = "_"))
tip_colors <- rad_samples %>% select(tip_label, Color) %>% deframe()

plot.phylo(rad_tree2)
tiplabels(pch = 16, col = tip_colors)
```

## Make figure
```{r, fig.width = 24, fig.height = 20}
# Extract UFboot and SH-aLRT values
support_values <- t(sapply(rad_tree2$node.label, parse_support))
shalrt <- support_values[, 1]
ufboot <- support_values[, 2]

# Replace labels with NA where BOTH values exceed thresholds
rad_tree2$node.label <- ifelse(shalrt >= 80 & ufboot >= 95, 
                           "supported", 
                           rad_tree2$node.label)

ddrad_tree <- ggtree(rad_tree2) +
        geom_tiplab(size = 4, family = "Helvetica", offset = 0.0001) +
        geom_point2(aes(subset = !isTip & label == "supported"),
                size  = 2,
                color = "black",
                shape = 16) + # filled circle
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        theme(legend.position = "none",
                axis.line.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
ddrad_tree

ddrad_tree + geom_text(aes(label = node), size = 2, color = "red", hjust = -0.3)
ddrad_flipped <- flip(ddrad_tree, node1 = 201, node2 = 124) |>
                 flip(node1 = 171, node2 = 125) |>
                 flip(node1 = 147, node2 = 127) |>
                 flip(node1 = 128, node2 = 135) |>
                 flip(node1 = 119, node2 = 120) |>
                 flip(node1 = 129, node2 = 132)


ddrad_flipped <- ddrad_flipped + hexpand(0.4)

            linewidth = 0.8) |>

        flip(node1 = 147, node2 = 127) |>
        flip(node1 = 128, node2 = 135) |>
        flip(node1 = 119, node2 = 120) |>
        flip(node1 = 129, node2 = 132)


rad_tree_fig <- rad_tree_flipped +

    scale_color_manual(values = branch_colors) +
    # geom_hilight(data    = clade_data,
    #             mapping = aes(node = node, fill = sp_col),
    #             alpha   = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    new_scale_color() +
    geom_cladelab(data = clade_data,

                color = "black",

rad_tree_fig
```
